name: John Nabozny
headline: Technology Executive | Ecommerce Expert | Salesforce Partner
about:
I’m an ecommerce executive who leads with data, drives with strategy, and delivers through execution. My focus is stability, reliability, and dependability.

Over the past two decades, I’ve helped global and national brands turn complex commerce challenges into measurable growth by uniting strategy, technology, and analytics under one cohesive vision. My leadership spans product innovation, digital transformation, and P&L accountability across high-volume B2C and B2B environments.

I specialize in bridging the gap between executive vision and technical reality. Whether it’s optimizing a Salesforce Commerce Cloud ecosystem, modernizing checkout architecture, or reshaping the digital customer journey, I anchor every initiative in measurable outcomes: conversion lift, margin expansion, and customer lifetime value.

Fluent in the metrics that matter. From AOV and mobile share to funnel efficiency and cross-channel attribution, I understand that executive decisions should be powered by statistical clarity. Years of experience has provided and honed deep intuition. My teams thrive on that principle: think like strategists, act like operators, measure like analysts.

As a leader, I focus on clarity, accountability, and sustainable scale. Empowering cross-functional teams to execute with precision and purpose. I’ve built data-driven organizations that operate with transparency, speed, and confidence in their numbers.
… more

experiences.description:
Worked with Michaels Stores, Inc to perform on-going maintenance, as well as assign with architectural issues, the implementation of best practices in the development process, and assisted in the creation of additional web properties on the Demandware platform.

Worked with The Acquity Group in putting together a proposal for a prospective client. I also worked to put together all documentation required, performed all scoping for the project, as well as participated in strategy meetings and the final sales presentation.

Involved with Guthy Renker with the implementation of multiple web properties on the Demandware platform. I also created and implemented a set of best practices for their release schedule and build process based on their unique experience with the Demandware platform. Additional services for Guthy Renker include architectural design, ensuring Demandware functions with their legacy systems and third parties, and technical decision making while maintaining scalability and reliability.

I worked on several large websites from the planning stages all the way through to producing deliverables.

Worked on the new site implementations for many big name brands including Kate Spade, Juicy Couture, and Starbucks.

I also provided technical insight and decision making for brands including PGeStore, Lucky Brand Jeans, Roots, and Carter's.

Two specific projects include:
    * Scoping and building a recurring order module. Customers could select a variety of products, select a frequency (1 week, 2 weeks, 4 weeks, etc) to receive that selection of products, and the orders would be automatically placed and shipped. If the customer's product or frequency needs changed, they could update their list of products or the delivery interval at any time without any interruption of services.

    * Scoping and building a flash based Facebook store to interface with our existing Demandware implementation. Products and prices were consumed by the flash file using an api I designed and implemented. The flash file displayed products, allowed size and color selections, and allowed the Facebook user to add items to their cart. All of this happened without the guest ever leaving Facebook or the fanpage of the retailer.
